def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n

def pedExtent : Q × Q × Q := (cm 30, cm 30, cm 90)

      [ ]

    Build.scene t (some 1)
      [ car (Units.metresPerSecond 15) (Units.metresPerSecondSq 1), pedestrian (-20) ]
      [ highway ]
      [ ]

      [ farHighway ]
